summary: Murf's Startup Incubator Program gives early-stage startups $1,500 in free Murf API (TTS/voice) credits for a 3-month period, one-time only. Overage beyond the credits is charged at $0.03 per 1,000 characters. Eligibility: under 10 years since incorporation, fewer than 100 employees, a fully functioning company website, and a valid use case for the Murf API. Decisions come within 1–2 days; the application is a HubSpot form.
claim_steps: Fill the application form linked from murf.ai/startup-program ('Apply Now').
Meet criteria: under 10 years since incorporation, fewer than 100 employees, functioning company website, valid Murf API use case (no reselling/non-compliant use).
Receive approval status within 1–2 days; on approval the credit plan is activated and $1,500 added to your account.

social_proof.title: Murf Startup Incubator Program — Get $1500 credits free for 3 Months
social_proof.text: The Murf Startup Incubator Program offers early-stage startups $1500 free credits for a 3-month period. If you exceed the $1500 credits threshold, any additional usage will be charged at $0.03 per 1000 characters. Program criteria: under 10 years since incorporation, fewer than 100 employees, fully functioning website, valid use case.
